# NovoTech Machine Tools Inc.

> Metalworking and metal fabrication machinery supplier in Mississauga, ON, Canada. Sells, installs and supports press brakes, laser cutters, shears, ironworkers, plate rollers, angle rolls, bandsaws, cold saws, rebar benders and cutters, pipe benders, hydraulic presses, punching machines, bevelers, deburring and finishing machines, notchers and press brake tooling. Machines are supplied with CSA-approved electrical panels and supported with spare parts and technical support from Canada.

Contact: +1 647 526 5510 · info (at) NovoTechMachineTools.com · 1365 Mid-Way Blvd, Unit 26, Mississauga, ON L5T 2J5, Canada.
NovoTech is appointing independent sales agents and dealers in cities and provinces across Canada; enquiries through the quote form on any product page or by phone.
Social: YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@NovoTechMachineTools · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/novotech-machine-tools-inc/ · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/novotechmachinetoolscanada · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/novotech_machinetools/
Brands represented include GMS GöçMakSan (rebar machinery), Dener (press brakes, shears, lasers), İşitan, Şahinler, Bekamak, Pilous, Gecam, CKEMSA, LFSS, Hidroliksan, Cevisa and EUROSTAMP tooling.

## Product pages

- [Rebar benders and rebar cutters (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-bender-and-cutter): every GMS rebar machine NovoTech supplies, with a single-bar capacity table for the whole range.
- [Rebar benders](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-bender): stationary B and BS series benders (Ø1″–Ø2-3/8″ / 26–60 mm), portable MG and BT benders on 110/220 V, SL stirrup benders, SX and AXIS 50S spiral benders, dowel bar benders, the MAX 40 combined bender-cutter and HB/MH mesh machines — specification tables in inches and millimetres, photos and videos.
- [Rebar cutters](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-cutter): hydraulic H series (H 26–H 55), mechanical M series (M 36–M 55), double-acting SH 45 and SH 60, and the portable POWER 24 — cutting capacities for one or two bars at 45/65/85 kg/mm² steel.
- [Automatic rebar processing lines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/automatic-rebar-processing-lines): SLS 12 CNC stirrup bender from coil, MATRIX 55 / 55S shear lines, SYNCLONE 45S servo double bender — technical specifications, capacities and videos.
- [Plate rollers & slip rolls (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/plate-rollers): İşitan plate rolling machines — hydraulic 4-roll and 3-roll plate rollers, motorized plate rolls and manual slip rolls from 2 ft to 10.2 ft, capacity table for all 134 models, plate roller buying guide.
- [Hydraulic 4-roll plate rollers](https://novotechmachinetools.com/hydraulic-4-roll-plate-rollers): İşitan 4R HMS 650–3100 (2.1–10.2 ft, plate to 1/2″) and 4R OM / HOM corrugated-sheet rolls; Şahinler 4R HS-L linear (3.4–6.7 ft), 4R HS orbital (5.1–13.5 ft, to 1″), heavy-duty 4R HSS (6.7–20 ft, plate to 3-3/8″), NC cassette-type 4RH and 4R HC cone rolls — all with NC / CNC, crane, side-support and ejector options.
- [Hydraulic 3-roll plate rollers](https://novotechmachinetools.com/hydraulic-3-roll-plate-rollers): İşitan MRM-H initial-pinch rolls 650–3100 (2.1–10 ft, to 1/2″) and 3R HMD; Şahinler double-pinch 3R HS 20-210 – 30-280 (6.7–10.2 ft, to 1-1/8″) and translating 3R UHS 30-450 – 30-680 (10.2 ft, plate to 3-1/2″).
- [Motorized 3-roll plate rollers](https://novotechmachinetools.com/motorized-plate-rollers): İşitan MRM-S 1050–3050 (21 models, composite-panel version), IRM 1050–2550, RM 1050–2050.
- [Slip rolls](https://novotechmachinetools.com/slip-rolls): İşitan IR motorized slip rolls, R manual slip rolls (bench and floor), RS manual plate rolls, RST / RST-M economical rolls.
- [Bead rollers & beading machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/bead-rollers): İşitan HIBKS / IBKS 4.0 and 2.5 hydraulic and motorized bead rollers (8 ga and 12 ga), IBKS 1.8, IKM / IKMP 1.2 motorized and IK / IKS manual bead rollers — roll sets, specification tables in inches.
- [Circle cutting machines, flanging machines & lock seamers](https://novotechmachinetools.com/circle-cutters-and-seamers): İşitan IDK-1 to IDK-5 circle shears (discs to Ø78.7″ in 3/16″) and LS-13P lock seamer; Şahinler SDK 6 / SDK 8 circular cutting and flanging machines for tank heads to Ø15 ft in 5/16″ plate and the EFM 6 elliptical cutting and flanging machine.
- [Compact hydraulic press brakes](https://novotechmachinetools.com/compact-hydraulic-press-brakes): İşitan Edgebender 1230 / 1540 / 2160 NC 2-axis press brakes (33–66 US tons, 4.2–6.9 ft) and the Edgebender 1240 CNC 3-axis with Cybelec Cybtouch 12 — Promecam tooling, Leuze light guard, specification tables in inches.
- [Pipe benders & tube bending machines (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/pipe-benders): every İşitan tube and pipe bender — CNC and NC mandrel benders, compact and aluminum-profile benders, BK rotary draw benders — with a capacity table for the whole range.
- [CNC tube benders](https://novotechmachinetools.com/cnc-tube-benders): İşitan SFB 38 / 51 / 65 / 76 / 90-CNC/A3 3-axis and SFB 38 / 51 / 65-CNC/A5 5-axis servo mandrel benders, Ø1-1/2″ to Ø3-1/2″ × 8 ga, 21″ touchscreen CNC with 3D simulation.
- [NC tube benders](https://novotechmachinetools.com/nc-tube-benders): İşitan SFB 38 – 90-NC hydraulic mandrel benders with 10″ touchscreen NC, SFB NC/C carrier models with servo rotation, SFB 32-HD / 32-M compact benders, SFB 38-NC/A aluminum-profile benders.
- [Rotary draw tube benders](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rotary-draw-tube-benders): İşitan BK-42, BK-050, BK-H 060 and BK 030 (76) non-mandrel benders for pipe to 2-1/2″ NPS, Ø3″ steel tube, solid bar, flat bar and box section — capacity matrix by material; Şahinler SPB 60 / SPB 76 NC pipe draw benders (Ø2-3/8″ and Ø3″, 500-program memory).
- [Tube notchers & pipe notching machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/pipe-notcher): İşitan PN 17/90 and PN 20/76 belt-sander pipe notchers (11/16″ to 3-1/2″ OD, any angle to 50°, ten dovetail drums included) and the TD-01 tube-end deburring machine.
- [Tube end forming machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/tube-end-forming-machines): İşitan SFF 90-1 / SFF 60-1 single-station hydraulic pipe-end formers that expand and reduce tube ends to Ø3-1/2″ × 14 ga, one tooling set included.
- [Angle rolls, tube rollers & section benders](https://novotechmachinetools.com/angle-rolls): Şahinler PK 30 / PK 35 motorized benders, HPK 40 / 50 / 60 / 65 / 80 / 100 / 120 hydraulic section and pipe benders (angle to L 4-3/4 × 4-3/4 × 1/2″, pipe to NPS 5), HPK 160–360 DP heavy-duty beam benders (to HEB 600, IPN 600, UPN 600, pipe NPS 16) and the TC-42 NC tube coiling machine — with a section bending capacity chart per model.
- [Hydraulic ironworker machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/ironworker-machines): Şahinler HKM 40 / 45 / 60 / 65 V single-piston (44–72 US tons) and HKM 55 / 65 / 85 / 115 / 175 double-piston (61–193 US tons) steelworkers — punching, bar, angle and flat-bar shear, notching; capacity tables and optional tooling.
- [Hydraulic punching machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/hydraulic-punching-machines): Şahinler HPM 30–175 single-head punches (33–193 US tons, holes Ø1/4″–2-1/4″, throat to 24.6″), HPM 65–175 DP double-head, HPM 85 / 115 / 175 CNC with 120 × 20″ Siemens table and HPM / HKM NC punching and cutting lines.
- [Hydraulic presses — shop and production](https://novotechmachinetools.com/hydraulic-press): Şahinler DPM shop presses 33–220 US tons, DPM-K / DK presses with mobile cylinder, AT universal T-slot presses and AP garage-type press brakes 110–165 US tons, DK-S 3-axis straightening presses 220–441 US tons; NovoTech premium-line production presses made in Turkey — HSA single action and HDD double action deep drawing H-frame presses (110–661 US tons standard, to 3,307 to order), HCFP column presses, CFS / CFSS / CFDD C-frame presses 33–276 US tons, SMC / HHRP hot plate presses, HSPS portal straightening presses, HDT Eco H-frame presses.
- [Hydraulic corner notchers](https://novotechmachinetools.com/corner-notcher): Şahinler HNM 4F (3/16″) and HNM 6F (1/4″) fixed 90° notchers and the HNM 6V variable-angle (30°–140°) notcher with T-slot table and automatic blade gap.
- [Pipe sanders & pipe polishing machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/pipe-sanding-polishing-machines): Şahinler BT 114-S automatic pipe polishing and sanding machine with pipe feeder — round pipe and square tube Ø3/8″–4-1/2″, straight or bent to 45°, two 37 × 2″ belts, inverter-variable speeds.
- [Cold saws — circular, carbide and automatic](https://novotechmachinetools.com/circular-cold-saws): İşitan SFC 350-VX semi-automatic and SFC 275 / 315-VP and -V pull-down circular cold saws (10-3/4″ to 13-3/4″ blades, round to Ø4-1/2″, mitre 45° both ways) and Bekamak automatic production cold saws — BMDO 75XS / 100XS / 130XS / 150XS TCT carbide saws for solid bar Ø3/8″–6-1/4″ with servo feed and a 20 ft magazine loader, and BMDO 80CS / 100CS HSS saws for tube and bar to Ø4″.
- [Metal cutting band saws / bandsaws (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/band-saw): horizontal metal cutting band saws (metal bandsaws, band saw machines for metal) in two lines — premium Bekamak (Turkey) and NovoTech's own value line (NT series) — with a capacity table for each line, a band saw buying guide (sizes, pivot vs double column, blades, speeds and feeds, troubleshooting) and FAQs.
- [Bekamak manual band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/manual-band-saws): BMS 230DG / 270DG gravity-feed double-miter saws, Ø9″–10-5/8″.
- [Bekamak semi-automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/semi-automatic-band-saws): BMSY DG/DGH double-miter, 320G/GL single-miter and straight-cut saws, Ø9″–17-3/8″ (230–440 mm).
- [Bekamak automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/automatic-band-saws): BMSO roller-feed, BMSO E encoder-feed NC, 350GA single-miter NC, GS servo-feed and 270DGS motorized-feed NC saws.
- [Bekamak double-column band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/double-column-band-saws): BMSY C / CGH / DG NC, BMSO C / CS / CGS / XS and heavy-duty saws from Ø13″ to 59″ (330–1500 mm), plus the GANTRY 2200XS gantry saw for rounds to Ø87″ (2200 mm) and 50,000 kg pieces.
- [Bekamak vertical band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/vertical-band-saws): vertical band saws for metal — BMSY 460VG semi-automatic tilting-frame miter saw (Ø18″), BMSY 613VT (23-5/8″ × 23-5/8″ blocks, 51″ cut) and VB 0814-8 (32″ × 55″ blocks, 26 ft cut, 40,000 kg) block saws, and the fully automatic CROSS 0626VT plate saw (23-5/8″ × 102″).
- [NovoTech value line semi-automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/affordable-semi-automatic-band-saws): BS-315GF full-hydraulic, BS-460G / 460G-JC, BS-2114TH, BS-5030 single-column, BS-650GA — hydraulic saws Ø10″–18″.
- [NovoTech value line automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/automatic-feed-band-saws): BS300x370 / 300x370H roller-feed, BS-5040 single-column, BS-460GB swivel-head miter saw with 20 ft stand, BS-650G scissor-type NC saw.
- [NovoTech value line double-column band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/twin-column-band-saws): semi-automatic TBK-4228 / 4228A, TGK-4235 / 4240 and GZ4250/70 / 4260/120 gantry saws; automatic TBK-4228B and BS-500G / 500GT / 850G CNC servo saws, Ø11″–23-5/8″.
